canonical_project: Continent 8 Gibraltar Data Centre (inside the Rock / COMCEN, Admiralty Tunnel)
notes: Operational secure hosting facility ~500 m inside the Rock of Gibraltar at the historic COMCEN/Admiralty Tunnel site; HMGoG minister visit (2024) and Continent 8 official Gibraltar location confirm; hosts gaming companies and the Government of Gibraltar under five-year hosting contract (Jun 2022-Jun 2027, awarded Sep 2022).
